title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
About Wolt
 At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.
Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.
Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.
Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.
 What You'll Be Doing
 You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.
Here's what your day-to-day might look like:
 Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
 Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
 Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
 Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.
 What You'll Need To Thrive
 Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:
 Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
 You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
 You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
 You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
 You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
 You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
 You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
 You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.
 Next steps
The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
 Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: Senior Product Manager - Platform Experience (all genders)
description:
JustPlay is looking for a Senior Product Manager - Platform Experience to join our Meta product domain and help shape a seamless, engaging experience that connects our games with the broader JustPlay platform.
At JustPlay, Meta is the layer between core gameplay and our rewards platform - including progress, rewards, boosters, LiveOps, and the experiences that connect each game to the wider JustPlay ecosystem. The Meta team owns this layer across our full game portfolio, extending platform features into games and building shared, reusable components that can be adopted across multiple titles. This helps us create a consistent player experience and scale new features across the portfolio without rebuilding them game by game.
In this role, you'll focus on making the JustPlay ecosystem feel seamless for players - identifying where the experience breaks between games and platform, turning those gaps into product opportunities, and setting direction around the solutions that can have the greatest impact on our key metrics. You'll work closely with Design, Engineering, Data, and game teams to align around priorities, make trade-offs, and drive outcomes across the ecosystem.
 What sets this role apart?
 You'll be building for an entire portfolio of 50+ games, not just a single title. That means thinking in systems, balancing the needs of different games and player journeys, and shaping solutions that can scale across the JustPlay ecosystem.
 Job Responsibilities
 Own the product strategy, priorities, and key results for your area within the Meta domain
 Identify and prioritise high-impact opportunities across the JustPlay ecosystem, balancing player needs, business goals, and technical constraints. 
 Drive complex product problems with a high degree of autonomy, from identifying the opportunity through launch, measurement, and iteration
 Collaborate closely with Design, Engineering, Data game teams, and other Product team members to shape solutions, align on priorities, and bring impactful features to life. 
 Translate player needs, business goals, and product insights into clear product priorities and solutions
 Manage priorities and trade-offs across multiple initiatives while keeping teams aligned on goals and outcomes
 Design and run experiments to validate hypotheses, measure impact, and continuously improve the product
 Contribute to a strong feedback culture by sharing perspectives openly, challenging ideas constructively, and actively giving and receiving feedback across the Product team
 Job Requirements
 5+ years of Product Management experience within mobile or another B2C digital product, ideally with exposure to mobile games, gamification, loyalty, or rewards products. 
 Proven experience owning a product area or domain, including strategy, prioritization, key results, and measurable outcomes
 Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with experience using data to make product decisions and evaluate impact
 Experience working with cross-functional teams, particularly Engineering, Design, and Data
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to turn complex challenges into clear product solutions
 Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, balancing priorities and adapting as new information emerges
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
 Comfortable giving and receiving direct feedback and contributing openly within the Product team
 Excellent English communication skills
 Job Benefits
 Work-Life Balance and Flexibility: Flexible working hours and options for digital nomads, occasional office visitors, or regular office-goers
 Mental Health Support: Free personal coaching through our partner OpenUp to support our team members to live fulfilled lives at home and at work
 Training & Development: A competitive personal development budget of up to 2000€/year for training, conferences, workshops, etc. and free language tutoring in German and English with Preply
 Germany-Based Benefits: 25 vacation days, free Wellhub gold subscription, free monthly Deutschland-Ticket, and a monthly €50 tax-free internet contribution
 State-of-the-Art Equipment: Doesn’t matter if you are a MacBook or Windows user; we will provide you with the technical gear you need to succeed
 A Relocation Package: Includes visa support for those who need it
 Berlin Office Perks: Ergonomic setup, free daily lunch, and a dog-friendly environment. 
 Engaging and Diverse Work Environment: Join a diverse team, with over 30 nationalities working from over 25 different locations
 Benefits may vary depending on location and contract type. Do not hesitate to ask us about more details on our benefits offer.
 About Us
 Come join the team building the engine behind rewarded mobile gaming – making playtime truly rewarding. At JustPlay, we’re on a mission to power a fairer, more sustainable rewarded gaming ecosystem where users earn real value for their time through a self-sustaining modell.
Since launching in 2020, we’ve grown into one of the world’s leading rewarded gaming platforms, with 25M+ downloads and 500K+ daily active users. Headquartered in Berlin and backed by NCSoft, one of the world’s leading gaming companies, we continue to operate fully independently – combining the speed, ownership, and ambition of a startup with the long-term backing of a global gaming powerhouse.
With a team across 20+ countries, we’re shaping a major shift in mobile gaming – and it’s still early enough for you to make your mark. At JustPlay, you’ll build end-to-end, move fast, and ship work that reaches millions – in a company that’s profitable, built to last, and focused on outcomes over hype.
 Everyone's welcome here
 At JustPlay, we believe different perspectives help us build better products. With team members from 30+ nationalities, different experiences and backgrounds are an important part of how we work and grow.

title: Product Manager Legal Tech & Automation (m/w/d)
description:
Unternehmensbeschreibung
Jede Geschichte zählt. Gestalte deine eigene – gemeinsam mit uns bei Riverty.
 Und wohin führt dich das? 
 In eine unserer 30 hybriden Arbeitsumgebungen – gestaltet für den Austausch von Ideen, gemeinsames Lernen und die Mitgestaltung unserer Arbeitsweise. Werde Teil einer internationalen Community mit über 4.000 Menschen aus fast 80 Nationen in 11 Ländern. Vereint durch eine gemeinsame Mission: Mit Empathie, moderner Technologie und datengestützten Erkenntnissen dafür zu sorgen, dass Menschen und Unternehmen im Fluss bleiben. Mit Zahlungsprozessen, die für sie erledigt werden – damit sie sich darum keine Sorgen machen müssen.
 Und das ist noch nicht alles: Wir sind Teil der Bertelsmann-Gruppe, die in Familienbesitz ist. Etabliert. Unternehmerisch. In einer dynamischen Branche. Wir ermöglichen flexible Bezahloptionen in verschiedenen Branchen, vereinfachen das Finanzmanagement bekannter Marken und unterstützen Menschen dabei, Schulden abzubauen und finanzielle Sicherheit zu gewinnen. Kurz gesagt: Wir gestalten FinTech.
Stellenbeschreibung
 Wir suchen Unterstützung als
 Product Manager Legal Tech & Automation (m/w/d)
 (unbefristet, Vollzeit) Schließe dich unserem Team an unserem Standort in Berlin, Verl oder Baden-Baden an – flexible Arbeitsbedingungen verfügbar
 Als Product Manager Legal Tech & Automation (m/w/d) verantwortest du eines der zentralen Produkte unseres Collection-Portfolios: die gerichtlichen Verfahren und die Zwangsvollstreckung. Gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams entwickelst du skalierbare, automatisierte und rechtssichere Lösungen, die unsere Collection-Strategie unterstützen und gleichzeitig den unterschiedlichen Lebenssituationen unserer Konsument:innen gerecht werden.
Dabei verbindest du regulatorische Anforderungen und operative Exzellenz in der Produktentwicklung zu einem leistungsfähigen End-to-End-Produkt.
 Deine Verantwortlichkeiten
 Own the Vision: Du definierst und treibst die Vision, Strategie und Roadmap für Judicial voran – mit dem Ziel, den Spagat zwischen Konsequenz und Rücksichtnahme für unterschiedliche Konsumenten- und Forderungsarten erfolgreich zu managen. 
 Skalierung und Self Service: Deine Lösungen sind für ein skaliertes Geschäft ausgelegt – und berücksichtigen dabei die viele Nuancen der Inkassowelt. Dazu gehört auch der Kontakt zu Mahngerichten, Vollstreckungsorganen und anderen rechtlichen Parteien. Du treibst Automatisierungsprojekte, verstehst rechtliche Bedenken und findest dafür erfolgreiche Lösungen. Dabei stellst du auch in hochautomatisierten Prozessen die Datenkorrektheit sicher. 
 Abhängigkeiten reduzieren & Teams befähigen: Als zentraler Prozess im Inkasso hat Legal Recovery sehr viele Beteiligte. Du verbindest Fachbereiche, Operations und Tech zu einem gemeinsamen Zielbild und schaffst Strukturen, in denen Teams eigenverantwortlich arbeiten und Entscheidungen treffen können. Dabei führst du bisher getrennte arbeitende Teams in einen neuen Gesamtbereich mit einem gemeinsamen Zielbild. 
 Optimiere dein Produkt kontinuierlich: Mit deinen Product Team verfolgst du kontinuierlich die KPIs deiner Lösungen und optimierst diese – ob mit Impulsen von außen oder aufgrund eigener Forschung. 
 Gestalte die Zukunft des gerichtlichen Inkassos: Du beobachtest regulatorische Entwicklungen, technologische Trends und neue Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten und integrierst diese gezielt in dein Produkt. Dabei evaluierst du innovative Ansätze – beispielsweise im Bereich KI oder Workflow-Automatisierung – und überführst erfolgreiche Lösungen in den Produktstandard. 
 Teams verbinden & Stakeholder orchestrieren: Du arbeitest eng mit weiteren Product Teams, Tech, Operations und kundenverantwortlichen Teams zusammen und sorgst für klare Prioritäten und abgestimmte Roadmaps 
 Priorisierung & Discovery: Du identifizierst Bedürfnisse von Nutzer:innen und Stakeholdern, validierst Hypothesen und priorisierst datenbasiert die Weiterentwicklung deines Produkts. 
 Qualifikationen
 Das Bringst Du Mit
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift 
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung (mindestens drei Jahre) im Product Management – idealerweise im Inkasso-, FinTech-, B2B-SaaS- oder einem vergleichbaren regulierten Umfeld. 
 Interesse daran, dich tief in die Welt gerichtlicher Mahnverfahren und der Zwangsvollstreckung einzuarbeiten und regulatorische Anforderungen in moderne Produktlösungen zu übersetzen. 
 Erfahrung im Aufbau skalierbarer und automatisierter Prozesse sowie ein gutes Verständnis moderner Automatisierungs-, Workflow- oder KI-Lösungen 
 Erfahrung im Umgang mit Datenanalyse- und Process-Mining-Tools (z. B. Celonis oder vergleichbare Plattformen). 
 Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, rechtliche, wirtschaftliche, technische und nutzerorientierte Anforderungen in ein überzeugendes Produkt zu überführen. 
 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams sowie im Management komplexer Stakeholder-Landschaften. 
 Eigeninitiative, unternehmerisches Denken und Freude daran, Veränderungen aktiv voranzutreiben. 
 Zusätzliche Informationen
 Informationspflichten Im Zusammenhang Mit Der Erhebung Deiner Personenbezogenen Daten
 Verantwortlicher für den Datenschutz bei deiner Bewerbung ist die in der Stellenausschreibung angegebene Firma. Die Firma verarbeitet deine Daten zwecks Begründung eines Beschäftigungsverhältnisses auf Grundlage des Art. 6 (1) b DSGVO /
 26 (1) 1 BDSG.
 Die Speicherdauer deiner Daten richtet sich an den Fristen des jeweiligen Landes aus beginnend mit Abschluss des Einstellungsprozesses. Diese findest du hier.
Den Datenschutzbeauftragten der Firma kannst du unter der o.g. Postanschrift erreichen.
Weitere Informationen zum Datenschutz und zu deinen Rechten erhältst du hier.

title: Senior Systems Product Manager, GTM Systems (d/f/m)
Product Owner (UX)
description:
About Revolut
 People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.
As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.
 About The Role
 The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions — collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.
We’re looking for a Product Owner who knows how to take responsibility over a product roadmap, including day-to-day operations, project execution, and addressing risks. From conception to launch and beyond, you’ll collaborate cross-functionally and communicate with senior management to be the go-to person for your feature.
Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.
 What You’ll Be Doing
 Setting your team's goals, success metrics, and roadmap to align with company goals
 Driving maximum impact based on data analysis, market research, and company strategy
 Completely owning your team's products, from ideation, through development, to launch, growth, and maintenance
 Working closely with Design and UX teams to define the customer journey and create an amazing user experience
 Liaising with Engineering to ensure effective delivery of your product
 Partnering with other stakeholders, such as Marketing, Legal, and Strategy teams
 What You'll Need
 3+ years of experience at a high-growth tech company or in banking/finance-related business areas (acquiring, payments, investments, cryptocurrency, insurance, etc.)
 2+ years of proven success leading consumer-facing mobile products
 1+ years of experience managing people
 Outstanding communication skills
 An eye for great UX/UI and impeccable understanding of design best practices
 High analytical acumen along with solid business sense that guides ROI-based prioritisation
 Experience formulating and driving a focused product vision, and owning the narrative with leadership, customers, and partners
 Experience leading product development and launch from scratch
 A readiness to provide insight and deliver measurable results under ambiguous situations in a fast-paced environment
 An entrepreneurial drive to never settle
 Nice to have
 A bachelor’s degree from a top university
 Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.
 Important notice for candidates:
 Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.
 Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
 Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.
 We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.
By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. title: Data Product Owner (m/f/d)
description:
TL;DR 
 You own GlassDollar's company data as a product: what we collect, how good it is, what it costs and what we build next. You sit in the product team and report to our Product Owner.
 Our data has grown faster than our ownership of it. Feeds run, but nobody owns whether they keep running. Most relationship records aren't classified yet, and some signals users ask for, like headcount changes, have no reliable live source. Fixing that is the job.
 Who uses your work 
 People in vclOSSearch: lists, projects, PoC tracking, recommendations and weekly company updates.
 Our AI agents & search: Clear definitions, provenance, confidence and freshness, measured on our search benchmark.
 API and MCP partners: Stable definitions and fields to build on.
 Marketing: Directory, rankings and reports through a quarterly data release.
 When these conflict, the product wins.
 What you own 
 The datapoint backlog our engineers pull from, ranked by value, cost and achievable quality. You set priorities; engineers own building and running at scale.
 The data dictionary and schema as the source of truth.
 Signals: funding, acquisitions, shutdowns, case studies and headcount, with correct event dates and alerts when a feed stops.
 Data quality: coverage, accuracy, freshness and completeness, measured monthly.
 The data budget: vendors, APIs, scraping partners and scouting effort. You test sources on real samples before we commit, then negotiate.
 Human-in-the-loop work: what our scouting team collects and how it flows into the database.
 You join sprint planning and review, triage data errors reported by users and agents, and prototype and ship datapoints yourself before handing over what needs to scale.
 Your first 90 days 
 By day 90: relationship data is classified and measured, every feed has an owner and an alert, 3–5 new datapoints are live, and our search benchmark has moved against a target you set in month 1.
 Month 1: baseline
 Data dictionary v1 for the top 25 datapoints, with source, owner, user and quality numbers.
 Every pipeline, vendor feed and scraping job inventoried with an owner, runbook and alert.
 Quick win: Scale partnership data point collection.
 Next year's data budget as a business case with a cost per datapoint.
 Month 2: corporate–technology relationships
 Define corporations and relationship types: mention, partnership, PoC, implementation, investment, acquisition.
 Classify and clean existing records, report precision on a sample, and classify new records on arrival.
 Set a recall and lag baseline, then improve the relationship pipeline against it.
 Find a live acquisition source and keep acquired companies out of recommendations.
 Month 3: new datapoints and agents
 Run 6–8 time-boxed datapoint experiments, each ending in ship, kill or park. Ship 3–5.
 Add provenance, confidence and freshness to the top 25 fields, and make customer data (lists, PoCs, notes) usable by agents with proper permissions.
 Decide where we go broad and where we go deep, and publish a kill list.
 Start a monthly data review with product and internal customers.
 Who you are 
 Business-first, and technical enough to ship alone. You'd rather put a rough datapoint live this week than a perfect one next quarter.
 Must-haves 
 5+ years with company, market or B2B data in a product, data or operations role, ideally at a data business, marketplace or SaaS company.
 You've owned an outcome with a budget and trade-offs inside a product team.
 Fluent Python: you write your own scrapers and enrichment scripts (requests or Playwright, pandas).
 Strong SQL on a production Postgres database.
 Hands-on with LLMs for extraction and classification, measured on a labelled sample.
 Practical entity resolution and deduplication.
 Working knowledge of GDPR for company and people data.
 You explain data trade-offs clearly to non-technical colleagues and leadership.
 Based in Berlin, or willing to relocate.
 Nice to have 
 German at reading level: DACH registers are a big part of our upside.
 Buying data from providers such as PitchBook, Crunchbase, Dealroom or company registers.
 Event or signal pipelines: change detection, event dating, alerting.
 Knowledge of the corporate innovation, VC or emerging technology ecosystem.
 Stack: Postgres, Hasura, Python, PostHog and LLM APIs.
 What this role is not: 
 Not BI or analytics: no dashboards for their own sake.
 Not a data platform architect: engineers own infrastructure.
 Not ML research: you use models, you don't train them.
 Not customer workspace data (projects, departments, exports): that stays with product engineering.
 Not team-building from day one: you lead through scope and priorities.
 How we hire: 
 Intro call (30 min) with our CEO: your background and a data trade-off you owned.
 Paid case (about one day). Around 500 companies from our database with their corporate relationship records. Classify the relationships and report precision on a sample, cost per record, and what you'd do with records you can't classify cleanly.
 Case review (60 min) with our Product Owner and an engineer: your code, quality checks and trade-offs.
 Team conversations (2 × 30 min) with sales and customer success, your internal customers.
 Offer.
 What we offer 
 Salary band: €80 – €150k base + equity
 Real ownership of a core part of our product, with a budget and a direct line to leadership.
 Fast impact: your data shows up for corporate customers, in agent answers and in weekly company updates within weeks.
 A small, senior team. Full-time, Berlin office.

title: Senior Program Manager (m/w/d) - Defence Innovation & Delivery
description:
(Senior) Program Manager - Defense Innovation & Delivery (m/w/d)
 Region: Deutschlandweit Remote / Hybrid in Berlin
 Branche: Defense Technology, Security, Public Sector, Data & Analytics
Ihre Mission
 Für ein stark wachsendes Technologieunternehmen im Bereich Defense & Security suchen wir mehrere (Senior) Program Manager (m/w/d) . Das Unternehmen entwickelt innovative Software- und Datenanalyseplattformen, die von Behörden, Sicherheitsorganisationen und weiteren öffentlichen Auftraggebern genutzt werden.
 In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für den gesamten Lebenszyklus strategischer Programme - von der Identifikation konkreter Kundenbedarfe über die Entwicklung von Pilotprojekten und Prototypen bis hin zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und Skalierung komplexer Kundenprogramme. Dabei arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle von Business Development, Produktentwicklung, Delivery und öffentlichen Auftraggebern.
Aufgaben
 Entwicklung neuer Projekt- und Programmideen auf Basis von Kundenanforderungen und Marktpotenzialen
 Aufbau und Steuerung von Pilotprojekten, MVPs und Demonstratoren
 Verantwortung für die erfolgreiche Umsetzung komplexer Programme und Projekte im Defense-, Security- und Public-Sector-Umfeld
 Steuerung von Zeit-, Budget-, Ressourcen- und Risikomanagement
 Zusammenarbeit mit Behörden, Verteidigungsorganisationen und weiteren öffentlichen Auftraggebern
 Enge Abstimmung mit internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Partnern
 Aufbau nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu Entscheidern und Anwendern

title: Staff Hardware Technical Program Manager
description:
About Us
 Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.
The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.
 Role Summary
 As Hardware Technical Program Manager (TPM) , you will serve as the central technical liaison driving joint vehicle programs between our engineering teams and Volkswagen, Audi, and Porsche. Based out of our Berlin hub, you will bridge the gap between our US-based core engineering teams and our European brand partners, aligning complex hardware requirements, program roadmaps, and architectural decisions.
Rather than managing tier-level supply chains, your focus is entirely collaborative and strategic: orchestrating alignment across brand engineering groups, manufacturing plants, and internal hardware teams to turn ambitious vehicle programs into production reality.
This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.
 Responsibilities
 Serve as the hardware integration partner for VW, Audi, and Porsche in parallel, keeping alignment across the three brands on requirements, schedules, and decisions.
 Own hardware integration schedules, milestones, and readiness gates across assigned vehicle programs, from prototype builds (EVT, DVT) through production validation.
 Drive engineering change management, including Program Change Requests (PCRs), impact assessments, and approval through partner boards.
 Coordinate with internal hardware development and validation teams, and bridge the time difference between the US home base and European partners.
 Track and close hardware issues and open action items, with clear owners and due dates.
 Lead cost-reduction initiatives on hardware platforms, including proposal reviews and status reporting.
 Represent hardware integration in program reviews, quality boards, and steering meetings, preparing decisions and clear status updates for leadership.
 Maintain the Brand Technical Responsible (BTV) interface, collecting partner feedback and turning it into prioritized actions.
 Help build and grow the European partnering team over time, including hiring and onboarding as the program scales.
 Qualifications
 Minimum Qualifications:
 Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
 Strong background in hardware development and/or hardware validation, with enough technical depth to challenge engineering decisions and follow test results.
 Generalist profile: comfortable moving between hardware design, validation, program management, and partner alignment.
 Experience in automotive or another safety-critical industry, ideally across development phases (EVT, DVT, PVT).
 Fluent German and very good English, both written and spoken, for daily work with brand partners and with colleagues in the US.
 High stress resistance: able to keep priorities clear and communicate calmly during tight deadlines, escalations, and launch pressure.
 Agile working style: experience running work in sprints or iterative cycles, adapting plans quickly, and working in cross-functional teams.
 Comfortable working across time zones, with regular overlap with US colleagues.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Experience working with OEM partner programs, ideally with multiple brands in parallel.
 Experience with automotive change management processes and PCR or ECR workflows.
 Familiarity with zonal architectures, vehicle networking, or ECU platforms such as XMM, RFM, or VAS.
 Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) is a plus.
 Total Rewards
 We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.
Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.
In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs .
 External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site ( https://rivianvw.tech/#careers ). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board .
 Equal Opportunity
Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws re

title: Senior Project Manager Utilities Platforms (all genders)
description:
Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso.
 DEINE ROLLE
 Berate bei Plattformeinführungen für Energiewirtschaftsunternehmen: Du berätst Kunden unserer Plattformpartner in den fachlichen Disziplinen Abrechnung, technisches Gerätewesen, Tarifierung, Marktkommunikation oder Finanzbuchhaltung (inkl. Nebenbuch) konzeptionell im Handlungsfeld der Einführung von Abrechnungsplattformen in den Marktrollen Netz, Messstellenbetrieb oder Lieferant.

 Steuere Anforderungen: Du nimmst fachliche Anforderungen auf, bewertest, priorisierst und denkst sie in komplexen Umgebungen neu, an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachabteilung und IT.

Idealerweise bringst du erste Migrationserfahrung mit.

 Spezialwissen: Kenntnisse in mindestens einem der folgenden Bereiche: Meter2Cash-Prozess; Netz-/Vertriebsabrechnung und Tarifbau; Technisches Gerätewesen; energiewirtschaftliche Regulierung und Gesetze. Marktkommunikation, Datenaustausch und EDIFACT-Marktformate; Messwertmanagement und Ersatzwertbildung; Nebenbuchhaltung und Finanzbuchhaltung.
 KI Kompetenz: Du setzt KI-Tools in deinem Fachgebiet souverän ein, bewertest die Ergebnisse kritisch und unterstützt Kunden und adessi dabei, Potenziale von KI zu nutzen.
 Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
 Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi.
Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

title: Product Owner Protocols and Smart Charging
description:
**Company Description**
Vattenfall is one of the largest energy companies in Europe. We make electricity and heat and supply energy to millions of customers. We do this in Sweden, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, Denmark, Finland and the Netherlands.
Vattenfall is a European energy company with approximately 21 000 employees. We are at the forefront of the transition to a sustainable energy system. To achieve this ambitious goal, we are looking for talented individuals who, in addition to their passion for their own role, also have a strong team spirit and want to contribute to supporting a meaningful company mission.
 **Job Description**
**There’s a way to turn smart charging into smarter energy use**
At Vattenfall, we exist to help our customers power their lives in ever more climate-smart ways. E-Mobility plays a key role in accelerating the transition to fossil-free transportation, and digital innovation is at the heart of that journey.
We are now looking for a passionate and experienced **Product Owner Protocols & Smart Charging** to join our international E-Mobility organization. In this role, you will drive the development and evolution of the applications and services that enable charger communication, smart charging, and energy optimization, helping us deliver reliable, scalable, and customer-centric charging solutions across multiple markets.
**Organisation** 
As Product Owner Protocols & Smart Charging, you will be part of the international E-Mobility organization and work closely with developers, architects, business stakeholders, and external partners in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.
You will be responsible for the products and applications supporting charger communication protocols, energy management, and smart charging processes. By combining business insight with technical understanding, you will ensure these solutions continue to evolve in line with operational needs, customer expectations, and Vattenfall’s long-term strategy.
You will report to the **Director of Strategy & Product Development** within Business Unit E-Mobility.
**Responsibilities** 
As Product Owner, you will define and drive the vision, roadmap, and priorities for applications within the Protocols & Smart Charging domain.
Your responsibilities include:
* Developing and maintaining the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for smart charging and communication platforms.
* Ensuring applications support both business and technical requirements while contributing to E-Mobility’s strategic objectives.
* Managing the product backlog and prioritizing features, enhancements, and improvements based on business value.
* Driving the implementation of new capabilities, including documentation, training, and change management activities.
* Supporting the development, maintenance, and scaling of energy management and charger communication solutions.
* Working closely with cross-functional teams to deliver customer-centric and value-driven products.
* Managing relationships with internal and external IT suppliers to ensure reliable operations and continuous improvement.
* Ensuring systems support efficient operational processes, financial handling, and compliance requirements.
* Evaluating how new increments fit within the broader application lifecycle and architecture landscape.
* Communicating product strategy, priorities, and recommendations effectively to senior stakeholders and leadership teams.
This position can be based in **Amsterdam, Solna, or Berlin**.
 **Qualifications**
**Who are you?** 
We are looking for someone who combines strong product ownership capabilities with technical understanding and a passion for sustainable mobility.
You bring:
* A Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Operations, or a related field.
* Experience within E-Mobility, ideally working with energy management systems, smart charging solutions, or communication platforms.
* Strong understanding of digital product development and application lifecycle management.
* Experience working in Agile environments and with Scrum methodologies.
* Knowledge of energy management concepts and IoT-based communication principles.
* Proven ability to manage complex stakeholder landscapes in an international matrix organization.
* Experience developing product strategies and presenting recommendations to senior management or executive stakeholders.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* The ability to collaborate effectively across teams, disciplines, and countries.
As a person, you are proactive, action-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership in situations where not everything is clearly defined. You are resilient, adaptable, and continuously look for opportunities to improve processes, products, and outcomes. Most importantly, you enjoy translating complex challenges into practical and impactful solutions.
 **Additional Information**
**Our offer** 
Good remuneration, a challenging and international work environment, and the possibility to work with some of the best in the field. You will be working in interdisciplinary teams and you can always count on support from committed colleagues. We offer attractive employment conditions and opportunities for personal and professional development. 
**More Information** 
We welcome your application in English, no later than, 10th of November 2026. We kindly request that you do not send applications by any means other than via our website and that you refrain from submitting a cover letter with your application. You apply quickly and easily by answering screening questions and attaching your CV. 
For more information about the recruitment process you are welcome to contact our senior recruiter Joany van Megen via email: joany.vanmegen@vattenfall.com.

title: Program Manager - Germany
description:
Job title: Program Manager
 Department: Missions Line of Business
 Location: Munich or Berlin, Germany

 Why this role matters
 Deliver complex Satellite Mission programs end-to-end, ensuring customer success, on-time execution, and scalable delivery excellence.
You will ensure the full lifecycle of customer missions—from contract execution through delivery—acting as the central orchestrator across engineering, product, operations, and commercial teams. Your role is to ensure programs deliver against commitments while building strong, trusted customer relationships.
This role directly contributes to ICEYE’s ambition to become the leading provider of space-based ISR infrastructure by scaling reliable, high-impact mission delivery globally.
The role will be based in Munich or Berlin. Regular travel to Espoo (Finland), and customer sites is required.
 Who We Are
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 Identify, manage, and resolve risks, dependencies, and escalations to ensure uninterrupted program delivery

 Implement scalable program management practices that improve delivery reliability and efficiency across Missions
 Establish effective reporting structure and communication channels and mechanisms to ensure timely and accurate information flow among program team members, stakeholders, and senior leadership
 Must Haves

 Proven experience (5–10 years) managing complex, multi-stakeholder programs involving advanced technology systems (e.g., space, defence, telecom, automotive, IT, or similar)

 Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams

 Benefits
